New research: Mindfulness-Oriented Recovery Enhancement (MORE) cut opioid misuse by 45% at 9-month follow-up in a 250-person RCT.
Not willpower. Not a pill. Mindfulness — rebuilding the capacity to savor what's good. Benefit-to-cost ratio: 84:1.
Sometimes the most powerful intervention is the simplest.
